title: Understanding Mean-Centering
text: Mean-centering involves adjusting the data so that each feature has a mean of zero. This process affects the intercept term in linear regression. Consider how centering might influence the intercept when comparing the models.

title: Intercept in Mean-Centered Data
text: When data is mean-centered, the intercept term often changes. Think about how the intercept is calculated and what happens to it when the mean of the data is zero.

title: Effect of Mean-Centering on Intercept
text: If the mean of each feature is zero, what does this imply about the intercept term in the regression model?
